answer: Twin execution proves a claim twice. A lantern warden hands the claimed job to two blind strangers, who each finish it live in an hour. The warden matches both outputs against each other and a sealed reference; a comet marks any stray line, and the lotus opens if both petals match. A twin mismatch voids the claim and bars the claimant a week. An honest worker pays five cents and one real job; 1,000 fakes must stage 2,000 live executions for $50.
